prompt_fragment: This asset is a card face. Compose for a vertical 3:4 frame with a strong focal subject and room for card framing or overlay treatment.
raw_description:
Upper half: an Aurora Stack city at night — the vertical crystalline
spire colony rising tier on tier, every prismatic lens catching the
aurora above. Ember glow at the base from the Foundation Depths. Tiny
silhouettes of robed figures crossing bridges between spires.
Civilizational scale: a population of thousands readable in the geometry.
Lower half: plain warm dark surface for overlaid text, with a faint
ghosted silhouette of a spire-city watermark. Warm cream parchment frame.

formatted_prompt.scene: Ink and watercolor naturalist plate depicting a towering crystalline spire colony rising tier upon tier against aurora-streaked night sky, prismatic lenses catching cool green shimmer above while ember orange glows at the city's base, on aged vellum cream parchment.

subjects.description: Multi-tiered vertical ice-crystal colony, segmented prismatic lens platforms stacked skyward, tiny robed penguin silhouettes crossing arched bridges, civilizational geometry implying thousands of inhabitants, aurora shimmer refracting across every polished face
subjects.position: upper half, centered, filling vertical frame from mid-image to top

subjects.description: Slow prismatic aurora bands, cool wavering light pooling at spire rims and lens edges, ink-wash night sky in deep slate, faint star scatter, painted atmospheric depth not glow effects
Plain warm dark surface, faint ghosted watermark of a single spire rendered in dilute ink wash, aged parchment frame border with foxing, space reserved for text overlay
